body.title: Mail Desk
body.summary: The mailboxes the Mail Desk screens. A check reads each one every few minutes. A mailbox in observe mode only records what was decided and changes nothing in it; a mailbox in live mode files each email and starts the seat it is routed to.
body.emptyLabel: No mailbox is on the Mail Desk yet. Add one with: cc-devthrottle maildesk channel add <address> --provider outlook --machine <machine> --why "<why>"
